# statusdrift_sla_policy (Resource)

Manages a StatusDrift SLA policy.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "statusdrift_sla_policy" "production" {
  name          = "Production SLA"
  uptime_target = 99.9
  window_type   = "calendar_month"

  response_time_sla_enabled  = true
  response_time_threshold_ms = 500

  monitor_ids = [statusdrift_monitor.https.id]
  tag_ids     = [statusdrift_tag.critical.id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the SLA policy (max 255 characters).
- `uptime_target` (Number) Target uptime percentage (90.0 to 100.0).
- `window_type` (String) SLA evaluation window: calendar_week, calendar_month, calendar_year, or rolling_30d.

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the SLA policy is active.
- `group_ids` (List of Number) List of monitor group IDs covered by this policy (max 20).
- `monitor_ids` (List of Number) List of monitor IDs directly covered by this policy (max 50).
- `response_time_sla_enabled` (Boolean) Whether response time SLA tracking is enabled.
- `response_time_threshold_ms` (Number) Response time threshold in milliseconds (1 to 60000). Required when response_time_sla_enabled is true.
- `tag_ids` (List of Number) List of tag IDs for dynamic monitor selection (max 20).

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) The date/time the SLA policy was created, in ISO 8601 format.
- `id` (Number) The unique identifier of the SLA policy.
- `updated_at` (String) The date/time the SLA policy was last updated, in ISO 8601 format.
